summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the repository without committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs; __all__ exports Tab and Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one rich Text with click spans last; Opacity merges blended color via style + blended so meta is preserved; layout_resolve needed no change because Edge already has size, min_size, and fraction. Tests: appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and tests/renderables/test_opacity.py; new tests/test_tabs.py. Docs: docs/reference/tabs.md with the single Tabs directive. The sandbox demo was skipped as optional. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so the tests are unverified; the code was checked by reading against rich 11.2.0. Judgment calls: bar position is a full-list index mapped to displayed slots by name; letter search applies only to single-character keys; zero-width label edges are excluded from the resolver; tests read the private _active_tab_name in places.
